taxonomy_note: Initial root-cause lens; reassess final mapping.

controls.boundary: XML external entities and parser capabilities — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Identify the actual parser factory/options and every XML entrypoint, including document converters and secondary parses. Record whether DTDs, external general/parameter entities or schemas can resolve resources.
controls.controlled_verification: Use a local parser fixture with an owned inert file or callback and a normal XML control. Observe actual resolver/file access at the parser, keeping entities and document size bounded. If an import preprocesses XML, trace the parser after preprocessing too.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: The presence of a DOCTYPE or an old parser dependency is not external resolution. A DNS event alone may establish resolution but not file disclosure or internal-service access.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Use supported parser configuration that disables unneeded external resolution, or a tightly controlled resolver when required. Retest legitimate documents and the evidenced resolution path at every affected parser instance.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
